description: Measures GPU cache/memory latency using single-thread pointer chasing over a random Hamiltonian cycle. Array size determines the targeted cache level (L1, L2, or global DRAM). Reports latency in nanoseconds per access.

scaling_param.name: array_bytes
scaling_param.description: Size of the pointer-chasing array in bytes; determines which cache level is targeted

non_scaling_params.name: num_accesses
non_scaling_params.description: Number of pointer-chasing steps per kernel launch
